QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Riena Strait
QuestInfo.0:
The sea level around the Riena Strait glaciers has seen a suspiciously dramatic rise. See if you can find out what's going on, before it puts anyone in danger.


- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 50 - 60 

- #eRoute#n 

   1) [Riena Strait] Get it Strait quest 

   2) Talk to Puro in Lith Harbor to move to Rien, then start from there. 

- #eFinal Rewards#n 

   #i1142629#  #t1142629# 

   #i1012389#  #t1012389#
